Purchase orders specifications and documentation
Can I use my own purchase order reference?
Include it in the description and main portal order process. The company order reference remains the tracking identifier.

title: Purchase orders specifications and documentation
text:
Purchase orders specifications and documentation
Can one purchase order contain several styles?
Provide each style, colour and quantity breakdown. Minimums, approvals and milestones must be clear for every line.

title: Purchase orders specifications and documentation
text:
Purchase orders specifications and documentation
What happens if my purchase order differs from the quote?
Resolve the mismatch before acceptance. The assistant identifies it for review rather than choosing terms.

title: Purchase orders specifications and documentation
text:
Purchase orders specifications and documentation
Can you resend my approved quotation or order confirmation?
Request it through an authorised account or support. This release does not fabricate or directly download missing commercial documents.

title: Purchase orders specifications and documentation
text:
Purchase orders specifications and documentation
Can I upload my technical pack into the chat?
Direct attachment upload is not implemented. Use the main portal's approved upload route and include its document reference.

title: Purchase orders specifications and documentation
text:
Purchase orders specifications and documentation
Can you generate an official invoice from my chat request?
No. Invoices come from the authorised finance system. The assistant can show available invoice fields or request review.

title: Purchase orders specifications and documentation
text:
Purchase orders specifications and documentation
What if two specifications disagree?
Use the latest approved revision linked to the order and resolve remaining conflicts with the team before production.

title: Purchase orders specifications and documentation
text:
Purchase orders specifications and documentation
Can you edit a signed agreement directly?
No. Amendments require authorised agreement. The assistant can prepare a request describing the proposal.

title: Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
text:
Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
Why did the delivery estimate change?
Check the accessible order's current timestamp and customer-facing note. Request a planning update if no reason is recorded; do not invent a disruption.

title: Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
text:
Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
Can I see an exact production line or machine allocation?
The assistant provides approved customer progress. Internal machine, line and employee allocation stays private.

title: Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
text:
Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
Can you put my order ahead of another buyer's order?
Request urgent review. The assistant cannot override priorities or disclose another buyer's schedule.

title: Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
text:
Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
Are weekends and holidays counted in lead time?
Working-day estimates use the scheduling backend calendar. Sampling, manufacturing and transport calendars can differ.

title: Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
text:
Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
Can you give a live available slot before I submit a purchase order?
A booking requires a dedicated planning API. This release reads milestones and prepares requests; it does not reserve capacity.

title: Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
text:
Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
What happens if a required material is delayed?
Planning records the effect and an approved customer update or alternative proposal. Substitutions and revised commitments need approval.

title: Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
text:
Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
Does a progress percentage guarantee the remaining duration?
No. Progress cannot be directly converted to days. Use the latest order-specific estimate and timestamp.

title: Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
text:
Planning capacity deadlines and disruptions
Can you run a what if simulation for my order?
Internal simulation is not exposed by this customer agent. Prepare a planning enquiry for an authorised review.

title: Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
text:
Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
Can I collect goods rather than arrange delivery?
Request logistics approval, including collector authorisation and release conditions. A ready stage is not collection permission.

title: Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
text:
Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
Can part of my order be shipped earlier?
Provide style, quantity and destination for partial-shipment review. Packing, freight and documents may change.

title: Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
text:
Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
What happens if a tracking number has no carrier update?
Report its recorded reference and last update for logistics review. No update alone does not prove loss.

title: Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
text:
Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
Can you change the consignee after dispatch?
Submit a logistics request. Carrier and customs restrictions may apply; acceptance is not guaranteed.

title: Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
text:
Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
Who is responsible for customs clearance?
The agreed delivery basis and contract determine responsibility. Do not assume one party always handles clearance.

title: Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
text:
Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
Can you insure my shipment through the chat?
Insurance can be requested for review. No purchase or binding insurance-coverage tool is configured.

title: Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
text:
Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
What if goods arrive with damaged cartons?
Preserve packaging and record delivery details, affected quantity and evidence for logistics and quality review.

title: Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
text:
Fulfilment export freight and delivery exceptions
Can you guarantee arrival before a public holiday?
No. Production, carrier service and customs must be reviewed before a delivery commitment.

title: Invoices payments refunds and finance support
text:
Invoices payments refunds and finance support
My bank says payment was sent. Is the order paid?
Only a verified finance record confirms receipt. A bank message or screenshot cannot mark the order paid.

title: Invoices payments refunds and finance support
text:
Invoices payments refunds and finance support
Can I pay by card inside the chat?
No payment processing is configured. Use the authenticated main-system process and never paste card details into chat.

title: Invoices payments refunds and finance support
text:
Invoices payments refunds and finance support
Can I change invoice currency after approval?
Request finance review. Currency, conversion and commercial amendments need approval.

title: Invoices payments refunds and finance support
text:
Invoices payments refunds and finance support
Can you change the company name on an invoice?
Request a correction with authorised account details. The assistant does not rewrite an issued invoice.

title: Invoices payments refunds and finance support
text:
Invoices payments refunds and finance support
What happens if I pay less than the invoice amount?
Finance reviews payment, balance and bank charges. The assistant cannot invent a release or write-off policy.

title: Invoices payments refunds and finance support
text:
Invoices payments refunds and finance support
Can you promise the date of a refund?
Refund amount and timing need an authorised finance decision. A complaint or cancellation request is not refund approval.

title: Invoices payments refunds and finance support
text:
Invoices payments refunds and finance support
Someone sent new bank details by message. Should I use them?
Verify instructions through the authenticated approved finance channel. The assistant cannot validate untrusted replacement details.

title: Invoices payments refunds and finance support
text:
Invoices payments refunds and finance support
Can the assistant approve a credit limit?
No. Credit is a finance decision. The assistant can prepare a review request.

title: Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
text:
Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
My shipment has fewer pieces than expected. What information is needed?
Provide order, delivery date, packing-list comparison, styles, quantities and evidence for a discrepancy request.

title: Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
text:
Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
What counts as a major or minor defect?
Use the agreed classification and inspection plan. The assistant cannot invent a universal acceptance list.

title: Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
text:
Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
Does an AQL value mean every shipment can contain that percentage of defects?
No. AQL is part of a sampling and acceptance plan, not an unconditional allowed defect percentage.

title: Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
text:
Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
Can I request replacement instead of a refund?
State your preferred remedy. Responsible teams review feasibility and the agreement before approval.

title: Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
text:
Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
What if there is an urgent product safety issue?
Mark the request urgent and report affected goods and evidence promptly. The assistant cannot make a legal determination or approve continued use.

title: Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
text:
Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
Can I dispose of the affected goods before review?
Preserve goods and evidence unless authorised instructions say otherwise. Disposal can prevent assessment.

title: Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
text:
Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
Can you check the status of an existing support ticket?
Ticket-status lookup needs an additional main-backend endpoint. Include the reference in a follow-up support request; this release does not invent its status.

title: Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
text:
Quality complaints remedies and dispute followups
What if I disagree with the proposed resolution?
Submit the specific disagreement and evidence for further review. The assistant cannot settle the dispute itself.

title: Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
text:
Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
Can I reorder the same style without a new sample?
Sales and quality confirm whether the specification and materials remain valid. Reorders do not automatically waive sampling.

title: Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
text:
Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
Will a reorder have exactly the same colour as an old batch?
Use the retained approved colour standard and bulk review. An old name or photo cannot guarantee exact shade.

title: Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
text:
Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
Can I reserve material for future orders?
Reservation, storage, cost and release terms need written agreement. The assistant can collect the requirement.

title: Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
text:
Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
Can we agree an annual supply programme?
Submit forecasts, quantities, dates and terms for sales and planning. The assistant cannot accept an annual contract.

title: Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
text:
Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
Can I schedule repeat deliveries every month?
A programme needs approved capacity, releases and terms. No recurring-order execution tool is configured.

title: Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
text:
Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
Can my repeat order use last year's price?
Sales must reconfirm current costing and validity. Previous prices are not automatically renewed.

title: Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
text:
Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
Can I duplicate an order directly from chat?
Prepare a reorder enquiry using the accessible reference. An accepted production order still needs the main workflow.

title: Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
text:
Reorders repeat buyers and long term supply
What if the previous style is discontinued or changed?
Sales checks the current specification and reviews alternatives. The assistant must not silently substitute a style.

title: Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
text:
Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
I cannot sign in. Can you reset my password?
Use the portal recovery process. The assistant does not collect passwords or reset credentials.

title: Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
text:
Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
Can a visitor track an order using only its reference?
No. Private tracking requires an authenticated authorised account.

title: Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
text:
Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
Why does the assistant say no accessible order was found?
The reference may be wrong or access may be missing. The response deliberately does not reveal whether another buyer owns it.

title: Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
text:
Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
Can I ask for all information the company keeps about me?
Submit a privacy request to the responsible team. The assistant does not automatically export all system records.

title: Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
text:
Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
Can you delete my orders immediately?
Deletion and retention need authorised review. Chat cannot delete order history.

title: Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
text:
Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
Does changing my name in chat change my account identity?
No. Identity comes from the verified credential. Chat cannot switch accounts or grant permission.

title: Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
text:
Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
What should I do if a request appears twice after retrying?
Keep the original reference and contact support. Confirmation retries use the same action identifier when the backend honours idempotency.

title: Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
text:
Customer portal privacy and troubleshooting
Can I use the assistant in Arabic or Roman Urdu?
A configured multilingual model can use the same knowledge and tools. Language quality requires testing; offline retrieval is primarily English.

title: Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
text:
Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
Can you fill my supplier assessment questionnaire?
The assistant can identify known information and missing evidence. It must not invent audit scores, certificates, insurance or financial statements.

title: Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
text:
Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
Can I receive a current certificate as a PDF?
Request its issuer, programme and scope from the team. The assistant does not generate or certify missing evidence.

title: Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
text:
Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
Does a certificate cover every factory and every product?
No. Check the covered site, product or material, scope and validity dates.

title: Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
text:
Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
Can you confirm ethical sourcing from a public directory entry?
A directory or old report alone cannot establish current compliance. Current approved evidence is required.

title: Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
text:
Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
Can you guarantee that all packaging is biodegradable?
No general claim is supported. Request the specific material and evidence for the actual packaging.

title: Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
text:
Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
Can you state the carbon footprint of my order?
No approved footprint data or calculation tool is supplied. Request evidence rather than inventing a number.

title: Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
text:
Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
What if a certificate has expired?
Do not present it as currently valid. Request renewal evidence or scope and date clarification.

title: Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
text:
Supplier audits certificates and sustainability
Can a web search replace an approved compliance document?
No. Search provides background; transaction-specific claims need approved evidence.

title: Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
text:
Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
Can you arrange a sales meeting?
Prepare a support request with topic and preferred time. A request is not a confirmed calendar booking; there is no meeting tool.

title: Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
text:
Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
Can you send an email to the sales team automatically?
This release records a request or submits it to the main backend. Email notification needs its configured notification workflow.

title: Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
text:
Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
Can you call me about my quotation?
Include a callback preference in a reviewed support request. There is no telephone or voice-calling tool in this release.

title: Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
text:
Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
Can you notify me each time my order stage changes?
Subscriptions and alerts depend on the main portal. This release does not create a notification subscription.

title: Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
text:
Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
Can you approve a machine repair to speed up my order?
No. Repairs and internal scheduling approvals are staff functions outside customer permissions.

title: Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
text:
Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
What happens if the order system is temporarily unavailable?
Report lookup failure and the next useful step. Reference records are never used as live fallback when the main backend is configured.

title: Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
text:
Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
Can you promise an answer to every company related question?
Use knowledge and authorised tools, ask for missing details and escalate unsupported matters. Never invent an answer to appear complete.

title: Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
text:
Service requests meetings and assistant boundaries
Can I confirm several different requests at once?
Review and confirm each prepared action separately. Each has its own identifier; submission and approval are separate.
